input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position in full. The cap in 21.1 is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000; "Fees" (1.5) means recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful and not illusory. 21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and, favourably to us, preserves data restoration, replacement services, notice and incident response costs as direct damages. 21.3 carves out (uncapped) breach of confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's payment of undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. 21.4 preserves independence of each cap and survival on failure of essential purpose. No competing or one-sided liability language appears elsewhere (18.1 is insurance only, with cyber cover of USD 5,000,000 sitting above the cap). No redline required.
